exactError: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'isDestroyed') at host.cjs:57:103
cause: The diagnostic will-quit listener queried webContents on a WebContentsView whose native contents had already been destroyed. Electron showed an uncaught exception dialog while quitting.
rootCauseScope: Confirmed for the build-8 diagnostic dialog. Older build-7 failures lack this line and are not retrospectively explained by it.

userDismissal.meaning: User acknowledged the uncaught-exception dialog; process disappearance is human-assisted.

automaticCleanupVerdict: not passed: user clicked 好 on the exception dialog before process disappearance
sourceCorrection: Remove object inspection from will-quit, retaining only the event marker. Regression invalidates webContents on close.
